firefly-no-beginner: Discovery mode is not compatible with the Firefly extension.
option.beginner.help: Play without the Evil Spirit: At the end of the game, the player with the Evil Spirit has to use it to cover one of their own Spirits, as chosen by their opponent.
option.firefly.help: Discover four new mischievous spirits and go in search of the mysterious fireflies that can give you instant victory.
